lesson.claim: A seal should carry an environment hash, or a later re-derivation cannot tell staleness from tamper: LIVEFREEZE-1 proves the script survives the lane, but nothing yet proves the ENVIRONMENT it ran in is the environment the seal assumed.
lesson.evidence: my round-1 refutation left the freeze conditional; this round I re-checked every LIVEFREEZE-1 record readable from this branch (L20 evidence + wave-69 worklog rows): script NAMES are receipted, environment content is absent — L18's half-life law generalized from scout items to environments
